Definition: from G3700; properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show:--appearance, countenance, face.
BiblicalUsage: Appearance is what shows on the outside. Jesus said, Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment, and John saw the Son of man whose countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe appearance is a poor judge: the face that shines like the sun belongs to the One whose judgment is righteous, and I am told to judge the same way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
